verdict.rationale: Plausible auto-tracks pageviews and scroll depth with no code, and can automatically track file downloads, form completions and external link clicks as goals via its script—covering much of the story. However, custom click/event tracking generally still requires adding data attributes or using the Events API/GTM, and one community comment notes the founders resist deeper user-flow tracking, so full automatic capture of all interactions isn't fully code-free.
